findings.title: Pre-selected optional choice
evidence: First observed checked: “Optional protection plan ₹399”. No user interaction with this control observed since monitoring began.
findings.interpretation: An optional choice was already selected at first observation. Earlier user choices or saved preferences cannot be ruled out.

findings.title: Possible confirm-shaming
evidence: Choice label: “No thanks, I love paying full price”. Matched a local guilt/negative-self-description phrase rule.
findings.interpretation: Declining is framed as a negative personal choice. Context can change the meaning.

findings.title: Unequal choice prominence
evidence: “Accept all” vs “Reject optional”: area 8.01×; font 1.70×. Threshold: area ≥2.5× or font ≥1.5×.
findings.interpretation: Acceptance occupies more visual space than rejection. This geometric signal does not assess intent or accessibility.

findings.title: Late-visible fee
evidence: Not visible in the initial fee baseline; now visible: “Platform fee: ₹149”. First observed 0.3s after monitoring began.
findings.interpretation: A fee appeared after the baseline. It may be a late disclosure or a legitimate recalculation; verify the checkout total.

findings.title: Suspicious countdown reset
evidence: Observed 0s → 12s after 12 descending samples; reset #1. Initial value: 12s.
findings.interpretation: The same countdown increased after counting down. It may create artificial urgency; a legitimate extension or new offer is also possible.

timeline.message: Local monitoring started; first visible state is the baseline.
